# A file mixing a transaction that must land with a sale that must not: the
# sale takes 150 USD from a basis holding 100. Importing the file keeps the
# good transaction and leaves nothing of the refused sale in the book.

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"

		value: "34.00"
